# Raft Design

> Raft Design is a bilingual AI-native studio working across the U.S. and
> Japan on brand, product, and digital experience. Founded by Lance Shields,
> a designer with twenty years of design leadership at Adobe and Walmart,
> and brand/product work with LegalOn, Visa, Hitachi, and Red Bull. The
> studio works hands-on, fast, and builds to move with change rather than
> around it.

## Studio
- [Home (English)](https://raftdesign.studio/): Studio thesis, practice areas, and origin story. Includes an "Engage" section (after Services) with two tiles linking to the Design Foundation Sprint and AI-Ready Design Systems pages below.
- [Home (Japanese)](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/): 日本語版ホームページ。「Engage」セクション（Services の後）に、Design Foundation SprintとAI対応デザインシステムへのタイルを含む。
- [Meet Raft](https://raftdesign.studio/about.html) / [日本語](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/about.html): Founder Lance Shields' background — design leadership at Adobe and Walmart, a decade leading a Tokyo design team, and why the studio is built to move rather than to look finished.
- [Labs](https://raftdesign.studio/labs/) / [日本語](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/labs/): Lance Shields' hands-on experiments in AI product design, prototyping, and emerging tools.
- [Contact](https://raftdesign.studio/contact/) / [日本語](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/contact/): Get in touch to start a project.

## Services
- [Design Foundation Sprint](https://raftdesign.studio/design-foundation/) / [日本語](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/design-foundation/): A four-week engagement for funded startups — brand system first, then the product screens that express it, delivered as a tokenized, documented design system rather than a one-off deliverable.
- [AI-Ready Design Systems](https://raftdesign.studio/design-system/) / [日本語](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/design-system/): Why and how Raft builds design systems that give both a team and its AI tools (Claude Design, ChatGPT, Cursor, and others) the same source of truth — brand rules, tokens, components, and DESIGN.md. Links to a real example, the [Raft Design & Brand System deck](https://raftdesign.studio/design-system-deck/) (English only).
